title: Catalog Feeds
content_data:
> **Important**
By using Catalog API endpoints, you agree to the [Product Catalog Terms](https://ads.tiktok.com/i18n/official/article?aid=6765817026859499525) and certify that you are abiding by the [TikTok Advertising Policies](https://ads.tiktok.com/help/article?aid=6685586866860720134). Please review these policies and ensure that the items you upload to your catalog don't breach them. A catalog is an asset that allows you to store information about the products you want to promote on TikTok. Using a catalog is a great solution for anyone who is looking for an efficient way to create and manage ads that feature a variety of products, like an online retailer. You can use feeds to fetch product information from your product database and update a catalog in your Business Center. Catalog Feeds API enables you to manage the feeds for a catalog under your Business Center. See [Overview](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1754263078057986) and [Guides](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1754263100123137) to learn about the concepts and benefits of catalogs, and to find out how to create and manage catalogs. This group consists of the following endpoints: * [Create a feed](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740665161957377) * [Get feeds](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740665183073281) * [Update a feed](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740665197662210) * [Delete a feed](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740665210863617) * [Get the log of a feed](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1740665225631810) * [Update the schedule status of a feed](https://ads.tiktok.com/marketing_api/docs?id=1750349624999937)
